title: fix(plugin-form,plugin-view,types): object-form resolves its seven I18nLabel members (objectui#10993, batch 1)
body:
Part of #10993
Clause-②: yes

Batch 1 of the family card: member 2, `object-form`, repaired end to end, and the census measured (table below). `ObjectForm` resolves the seven `I18nLabel` members of `ComponentPropsMap['object-form']` with `pickLocalized` against `useObjectTranslation().language`, once, above its `formType` fork, so every presentation it routes to receives a string. The registration declares both arms for the seven keys, `ObjectFormSchema` types them as `I18nLabel`, and the zod mirror takes the spec's `I18nLabelSchema` by reference for the five it declares. The other census members are not repaired here; the seat files or batches the raw reads from the table. Draft: a dispatched dev's PR (claim comment 5882993226, branch `claude/issue-10993-object-form-i18nlabel`), so ready and landing belong to the seat. Measured at head `aa6013903`, which carries main at `bf7ab35ce` (objectui#11000's PR 11047 included).

## What changed

- **`packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx`**: `localizeFormLabels` resolves `title`, `description`, `submitText`, `cancelText`, `nextText`, `prevText` and `successMessage` inside the dispatcher's `schema` memo, right after `foldFormButtons`, for the reason `sections[].group` is resolved above the fork: every presentation reads them, so one site covers the simple, tabbed, split, wizard, drawer and modal forms and the master-detail route. Only the map arm is touched: a string, or any non-object value, is handed on as authored, and a map with no usable entry becomes `undefined`, so the presentation's own default shows. It returns its input untouched when no member is a map. `LocalizedObjectFormSchema` (a homomorphic mapped type; `Omit` collapses on `BaseSchema`'s index signature) types the memo and `SimpleObjectForm`'s `schema`. `WizardForm.tsx`, `DrawerForm.tsx` and `ModalForm.tsx` are not edited: they receive strings.
- **`packages/plugin-form/src/index.tsx`**: the seven `object-form` inputs declare `type: ['string', 'object']`, with descriptions that teach the per-locale map, in the same change that taught the render site to resolve it (the `ComponentInput` rule, objectui#5590).
- **`packages/types/src/objectql.ts`**: the seven `ObjectFormSchema` members widen from `string` to `I18nLabel`.
- **`packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`**: `title`, `description`, `submitText`, `cancelText` and `successMessage` widen from `z.string()` to `stripImportedDefaults(SpecI18nLabelSchema).optional()`, the spec's schema BY REFERENCE (`I18nLabelSchema` is exported by `@objectstack/spec/ui` and was already imported here for the chart `title`). `nextText` and `prevText` were never mirrored and stay unmirrored (see Acceptance notes).
- **`packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx`** (outside the claim's file surface): `ObjectViewSchema.form` takes `ObjectFormSchema`'s slot keys, so the widening widened the `object-view` `form.title` / `form.description` with it, and plugin-view's type-check refused `ObjectView`'s two raw reads (the drawer and modal header it draws around the form). Both now resolve with `pickLocalized` against the same UI language. Measured below; the hunks stay clear of the regions objectui#10982 edits.
- **`scripts/check-spec-symbol-derivation.mjs`**: `ObjectFormSchema` leaves `CLAIM_DEBT`. `check:spec-symbols` refused the stale entry once the mirror referenced a spec schema; the block is what `--claim-ledger` prints.
- **Tests**: `packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.i18nLabels.test.tsx`, `packages/types/src/__tests__/object-form-i18n-label-members-10993.test.ts`, `apps/console/src/__tests__/objectFormI18nLabelManifest.test.ts` and `packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/ObjectView.formLabelsI18nLabel-10993.test.tsx` (new); seven `MEMBER_PINS` rows in `registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`; in `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`, `objectql.zod.ts#ObjectFormSchema` joins `SPEC_DERIVED_PAIRS`, so its `UnmirroredDeclared` entry (21 keys, none touched) moves from the split's LOCAL half to the SPEC-DERIVED half, and the header figures and history sentences follow.
- **`content/docs/api/schema-reference.md`**: the `ObjectFormSchema` table types the seven as `string \| I18nLabel`.
- **`.changeset/10993-object-form-i18nlabel.md`**: `@object-ui/plugin-form` patch, `@object-ui/plugin-view` patch, `@object-ui/types` minor (the widening), with the `Clause-②: yes` line.

## Premise checks

- **The row.** Enumerated at runtime from the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0 `ComponentPropsMap['object-form']`: exactly seven members are the `I18nLabel` union (`string` or a record of string to string), the seven the card names. `sections` and `customFields` type no nested label.
- **The red.** Reproduced before any edit, through the real `SchemaRenderer` under a `zh` provider: `{ type: 'object-form', properties: { objectName, mode: 'create', submitText: { en, 'zh-CN' } } }` rendered `Component "form" failed to render` with "Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {en, zh-CN})". It is pinned (red on base, below).
- **The readers, measured per presentation.** `SimpleObjectForm`: `submitText` and `cancelText` into the `form` node's `submitLabel` / `cancelLabel` (both of its render branches), `successMessage` into four success-toast sites. `TabbedForm`, `SplitForm`: `submitText` / `cancelText`. `WizardForm`: `nextText`, `prevText`, `submitText`, `cancelText`, `successMessage`. `DrawerForm`, `ModalForm`: `title` / `description` as the header, `submitText` / `cancelText` in the footer; neither reads `successMessage`. `EmbeddableForm` reads its own `config.title`, a different node. The master-detail route forwards `title`, `submitText` and `cancelText` to `MasterDetailForm`, which already resolves them (PR objectui#10986).
- **The validator, before.** `safeValidateSchema` refused a map on the five mirrored members (`invalid_type` at the member) and did not judge `nextText` / `prevText` at all (a map and a number both parsed). Separately, it refuses the `{ type, properties }` form of `object-form` wholesale (`objectName` `invalid_type`, `mode` `invalid_value`, even for `properties: { objectName: 'order' }`), because the arm is the flat mirror. That is reported, not changed here.
- **By reference.** Yes: `stripImportedDefaults(SpecI18nLabelSchema)`, which returns the spec object itself for a schema with no defaults.

## Evidence

All runs at `aa6013903` unless a line says otherwise, through the shared verify lock on a shared box.

- `pnpm exec vitest run` over `packages/plugin-form/` (in two halves, for the foreground cap): `Test Files 68 passed (68)`, `Tests 550 passed (550)`, and `Test Files 73 passed (73)`, `Tests 1115 passed | 1 skipped (1116)`.
- `packages/types/`: `Test Files 279 passed (279)`, `Tests 6432 passed (6432)`.
- `packages/plugin-view/` with app-shell's `block-config-schema-parity-8216.test.ts` and `block-config.test.ts`: `Test Files 61 passed (61)`, `Tests 630 passed (630)`.
- The registry-reading suites (the 15 console files that import `register-plugins`, including the parity gate and both I18nLabel manifest pins; cli `spec-vocabulary-hint`, `validate-union-arm-selection` and `registered-types-validate-ratchet-10859`; schema-catalog `catalog-gallery-render` and `safe-validate-corpus-6318`): `Test Files 20 passed (20)`, `Tests 999 passed (999)`.
- Every test that names `check-spec-symbol-derivation` (the gate script this PR edits): `Test Files 31 passed (31)`, `Tests 630 passed (630)`.
- `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/plugin-view^...'` (15 tasks), then `pnpm --filter` `type-check` for `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/plugin-form` and `@object-ui/plugin-view`, joined by `&&`: exit 0.
- Gates, each exit 0: `check-changeset-presence`, `changeset:check`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:spec-symbols`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:registry-bare-names`, `check:prompt-keys`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:component-surface-parity`, `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`. `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over the 14 paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- ESLint, narrowed and proven: the population is the config's own `files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}']` block over `tseslint.configs.recommended`; `--format json` over the 12 changed code files reports 12 files, 0 errors, 173 warnings, 0 of them on a line this branch adds. The config enables no type-aware linting (no `project`, `projectService` or `TypeChecked` in `eslint.config.js`) and no `eslint-rules/` rule reads another file, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.

**Red on base, then green.** The three fix files were committed, then replaced on disk by their `b3c96d6bc` blobs under a trap-restore, at `5d58ae2d8` (hashes equal to the base blobs; `localizeFormLabels` 0, object arms 3, i.e. master-detail's, spec `I18nLabelSchema` crossings 1, i.e. the chart's). `Tests 26 failed | 37 passed (63)`: the render pin's 7 map rows failed (simple, tabbed and split on `Component "form" failed to render`, wizard, drawer and modal on `Component "object-form" failed to render`, all "Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {en, zh-CN})"; the `successMessage` row on `expected [ '[object Object]' ] to deeply equal [ '订单已保存' ]`) and its 5 controls passed; the types pin's 5 map rows failed on `invalid_type` and 17 passed; the manifest pin's 7 arm rows and 7 map rows failed and 15 passed. Restored: hashes equal the HEAD blobs, `git diff HEAD` empty. `ObjectView.tsx` the same way against main's blob: `Tests 2 failed | 2 passed (4)`, the two map rows on "Objects are not valid as a React child".

**Type pin, reverse leg.** `ObjectFormSchema.submitText` narrowed back to `string` on disk: `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` fails with `TS2344: Type 'false' does not satisfy the constraint 'true'` on the `assertionLabelMembersAreI18nLabel` row (and `zod-mirror-parity`'s wider-than-declared ledger reds too). Restored by hash.

**Consumer probe of the built `.d.ts`.** A one-off file outside the repo, with `@object-ui/types` mapped to `packages/types/dist/index.d.ts`: locale maps on `title` and `submitText` compile; with its `@ts-expect-error` removed, `submitText: 42` fails `TS2322 … not assignable to type 'string | (Record … ) | undefined'`, so the rebuilt declaration is read and is not `any`.

**The render pin's harness.** Each row mounts inside an async `act`. With a plain `render` and `findBy…`, three rows that mount after certain earlier rows stayed on "Loading form..." past the find window, deterministically, and the same three did so on the base `ObjectForm.tsx` too, so it is not this change; committing the mount-time schema read inside `act` removes it. Every wizard map's `zh` entry differs from the zh pack's own default for that button (objectui#10999 moved the wizard's defaults to its catalogue), so a map dropped instead of resolved fails its row; the wizard's nothing-authored defaults are left to that card's pin.

## The census

Every installed (17.4.0) `ComponentPropsMap` row's `I18nLabel` members, enumerated at runtime by walking each row's zod shape for the string-or-record-of-string union, and each objectui renderer's read. 45 rows, 24 with such a member, 56 members: 7 repaired here, 33 already resolving, 6 raw reads, 9 with no read site, 1 with no renderer. "Measured" means a render through the real `SchemaRenderer` under a `zh` provider with an `en`-first map; the rest are read at the named site.

| Row | Member(s) | Read site | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| `object-form` | title, description, submitText, cancelText, nextText, prevText, successMessage | `ObjectForm` `localizeFormLabels` | repaired here |
| `object-master-detail-form` | title, submitText, cancelText | `MasterDetailForm` `pickLocalized(…, language)` | already resolving (PR objectui#10986) |
| `object-metric` | label, title, description | `ObjectMetricWidget` / `MetricWidget` `pickLocalized(…, language)` | already resolving; its inputs declare `'string'` only, measured `type-mismatch` on a map |
| `object-grid` | label | `ObjectGrid` `resolveInlineI18nLabel(schema.label, displayLocale)` (caption, export label, detail title); measured | already resolving; input `'string'` only, measured `type-mismatch` |
| `object-grid` | title | `ObjectGrid` `caption: resolveInlineI18nLabel(schema.label, displayLocale) \|\| schema.title`, a `TableCaption` child | **raw read**, measured `Component "data-table" failed to render` |
| `element:text` | content | `ElementTextRenderer` `pickLocalized(props.content, language)` | already resolving |
| `element:button` | label | `ElementButtonRenderer` `pickLocalized(props.label, language)` | already resolving |
| `element:text`, `element:button`, `element:image`, `element:number` | aria.ariaLabel | `ariaAttrs` in `elements.tsx`: `String(v)` under `aria-${k}` | **raw read**, measured `aria-arialabel="[object Object]"`; a plain string also lands on `aria-arialabel`, never `aria-label` |
| `element:text_input` | label, placeholder, description | `ElementTextInputRenderer` `pickLocalized(…, language)` | already resolving |
| `element:record_picker` | label, placeholder, emptyText | `ElementRecordPickerRenderer` `pickLocalized(…, language)` | already resolving |
| `element:text_input` | aria.ariaLabel | no read site; measured, no attribute | not read |
| `element:record_picker`, `element:metadata_viewer` | aria.ariaLabel | no read site in either renderer (runtime not measured: both need an adapter or a payload) | not read |
| `page:header` | title, subtitle | `PageHeaderRenderer` `pickLocalized(titleSrc / subtitleSrc, language)` | already resolving |
| `page:card` | title | `PageCardRenderer` `pickLocalized(schema?.title, language)` | already resolving |
| `page:tabs`, `page:accordion` | items[].label | `PageTabsRenderer` / `PageAccordionRenderer` `translateLabel(pickLocalized(it.label, language), …)` | already resolving |
| `page:header`, `page:card`, `page:tabs`, `page:accordion` | aria.ariaLabel | no read site in `containers.tsx`; measured, no attribute | not read |
| `record:alert` | title, body, action.label | `RecordAlertRenderer` `pickLocalized(…, language)` | already resolving |
| `record:related_list` | title, add.label | `RecordRelatedListRenderer` `pickLocalized(schema.title / schema.add.label, language)` | already resolving; `title` input `'string'` only, measured `type-mismatch` |
| `record:details` | sections[].label | `RecordDetailsRenderer` `pickLocalized(rawTitleSrc, language)` | already resolving |
| `record:path` | stages[].label | `RecordPathRenderer` renders `{o.stage.label}` and `stageAriaLabel(o.stage.label, …)` | **raw read**, measured `Component "record:path" failed to render` |
| `record:activity`, `record:chatter`, `record:details`, `record:discussion`, `record:highlights`, `record:path`, `record:related_list` | aria.ariaLabel | `useRecordAriaProps` → `useRecordAriaName` → `resolveInlineI18nLabel(aria?.ariaLabel, locale)`, the display locale | already resolving |
| `record:chatter`, `record:discussion` | feed.aria.ariaLabel | `RecordChatterRenderer` reads `feed`'s limit, types, filter mode and the rest, never `feed.aria` | not read |
| `ai:chat_window` | aria.ariaLabel | not registered in objectui (`palette-placeholder-blocks.test.tsx` pins the exclusion) | no renderer |

The table is a reading at `aa6013903` on spec 17.4.0 and is not re-derived by anything in this PR; the instrument is the enumeration described above plus the named sites.

## Acceptance notes

- **NOT MEASURED: `check:eager-closure` / Bundle Analysis and `check:sdui-registration-pins`.** Reason: both need a full console build. The seven input descriptions ship in the console's eager closure (`register-plugins` imports `@object-ui/plugin-form` eagerly).
- **NOT MEASURED: `check:doc-snippets` and `check:doc-examples`.** Both answered PRECONDITION NOT MET (exit 2): they need 34 packages built. The doc edit adds table rows and one sentence, no fenced snippet.
- **NOT MEASURED: `apps/console` and `@object-ui/app-shell` type-check.** Reason: their dependency closures were not built here. The console change is two test files. Outside plugin-form and plugin-view, a grep for reads of the seven members off an `ObjectFormSchema` or `ObjectViewSchema['form']` finds none that type-checks against them: `FormPage` reads a `FormViewBody`, and `ScreenView` builds its node through `as any`. CI's type-check is the reading.
- **`nextText` and `prevText` stay unmirrored.** They were never declared on the zod mirror, so `safeValidateSchema` does not judge them (a number parses). Mirroring them would REFUSE values accepted today, a narrowing this widening PR does not make; they stay in the pair's `UnmirroredDeclared` entry, and the types pin records it.
- **`DrawerForm` and `ModalForm` never read `successMessage`.** A source reading, not measured at runtime; recorded, not filed.
- **Two stale cross-file line citations sit in `index.tsx`'s `modalCloseButton` and `contentLayout` descriptions**, in the registration block this PR edits. Not repaired here: they are a different defect class from this card's. Carrier: none.
- **Main was merged three times (merge commits, no rebase):** `2eaf5be27` (objectui#10999, the wizard's catalogue defaults, which this PR's wizard rows now account for), `63ab76112` (objectui#11016's citation rewrite: one textual conflict, on a comment line in `ObjectForm.tsx`'s memo, kept both sides) and `bf7ab35ce` (objectui#11000's PR 11047, clean).
